description.value: Essence of India is a long-established Indian restaurant in the Garibaldi Highlands neighbourhood of Squamish, founded and helmed by Chef Don, who honed his craft across Greek, Italian, French, and Punjabi cuisines before opening this spot. The menu features classics like butter chicken, biryani, tandoori dishes, and fresh naan, with dine-in, takeout, and catering all available. It sits in a suburban commercial area and would serve as a warm sit-down meal stop for cyclists tackling the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

address.value: 40367 Tantalus Way, Garibaldi Highlands, Squamish, BC V0N 1T0
